An '''Ewoks stilt village''' was a structure built by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="ITW">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Each building was built upon stilt-assemblies sticking out of the water and had land-access through a series of bridges. These communities also constructed sailboats for transportation.

Some of the more notable villages were located on [[Lake Sui/Legends|Lake Sui]]. One known village was the [[Southern Ewok Lake Village]].
